description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source testing management tool. It retrieves a summary of a test case based on provided identifiers and formats it for display, likely as a tooltip via ExtJS. The script initializes the environment, interacts with test case management classes, and outputs HTML-formatted information.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: A class managing test case data interactions, including retrieval of test case information by ID and version.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves specific version information of a test case by its ID and version ID.

methods.name: get_last_version_info
methods.description: Retrieves the latest version information for a given test case ID.
